page_title: CEL 1-1 RSO | Celta Vigo v Real Sociedad 19/10/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+5' Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) receives a yellow card.
90+5' Juan Martinez blows his whistle after Ilaix Moriba (Celta Vigo) brings one of his opponents down with a strong tackle.
90+4' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the left post.
90+3' 4:15 – the total goal attempt statistics.
90+2' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) found some space to play in a lofted pass, but he looks disappointed as none of his teammates managed to connect with it.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' 1 - 1 Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) scores from quite a difficult position as he leaps high to connect with a cross and powers his header inside the right post. Excellent finish.
88' The linesman signals that Jon Karrikaburu (Real Sociedad) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.

88' Real Sociedad are playing possession football and controlling the game at present. They are exchanging inch-perfect passes from player to player, making it difficult for the opposition to win the ball.
85' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Fran Beltran (Celta Vigo) comes onto the pitch so that Pablo Duran can be given a rest.
85' Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) decides to keep the ball to himself and weaves through the defence into the box. From there he takes a shot which goes narrowly wide of the target.
84' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner, but the goalkeeper jumps and gathers the ball.

83' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) picks up the rebound inside the penalty area and releases a good shot to the middle of the goal. Unfortunately for him, Ionut Radu shows how quick his reflexes are and dives superbly to stop his effort. What a save but what a wasted opportunity!
81' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) smashes the ball towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but his effort flies just a few inches wide of the right post.
80' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
77' Ionut Radu leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad).
76' Here comes a substitution. Jon Aramburu is given a rest as he is replaced by Jon Karrikaburu (Real Sociedad).
76' Sergio Francisco has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Arsen Zakharyan (Real Sociedad) replacing Ander Barrenetxea.
71' The attendance for today's match is 19102.
71' Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad) had an opportunity from long range. His low shot was directed towards the middle of the goal, but Ionut Radu was alert and made a comfortable save.
70' We are about to witness a subsitution. Jones El Abdellaoui (Celta Vigo) for Ferran Jutgla.

70' What a poor attempt! Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) drives another shot towards goal - this time from further out, but it couldn't have been worse if he had shot blindfolded. The ball goes into the stands.
67' Here's the change. Aihen Munoz leaves the pitch and Goncalo Guedes (Real Sociedad) comes on as a substitute.
67' Sergio Francisco has decided to substitute Brais Mendez and he is replaced by Carlos Soler (Real Sociedad).

65' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) runs onto a loose pass inside the box and releases a tremendous shot towards the middle of the goal. However, Ionut Radu anticipates the shot and makes a decent save.
59' Jon Gorrotxategi (Real Sociedad) does well to dispossess the attacker with a slide tackle, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
57' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Pablo Marin (Real Sociedad) comes onto the pitch for Yangel Herrera.
56' Juan Martinez shows the yellow card to Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) for a heavy challenge.
56' Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
56' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders.
54' Claudio Giraldez has decided to make a change. Hugo Alvarez (Celta Vigo) replaces Borja Iglesias.
54' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Oscar Mingueza leaves the pitch and Javier Rueda (Celta Vigo) comes on.
54' Juan Martinez blows for a foul after Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.

51' Duje Caleta-Car (Real Sociedad) beats the defender inside the box and lashes a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Ionut Radu makes a brilliant reflex save to deny him. Goalkeeping at its best!
50' Celebrations are cut short for Real Sociedad as the referee indicates NO GOAL after the VAR review shows it was offside!
50' The Real Sociedad players halt their celebrations as referee Juan Martinez makes the VAR signal to review the goal, most likely to ascertain if there was an offside in the build-up play.
49' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) received a delightful pass inside the box before slotting the ball past the goalkeeper. What a brilliant finish!
47' Real Sociedad keep possession of the ball by producing short passes and one-two passes from player to player.
46' The teams are back out for the second half and here is a change on the pitch. Claudio Giraldez gives a chance to Carlos Dominguez (Celta Vigo) and Hugo Sotelo is off.
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle to end the first half and the players are now heading to their respective dressing rooms.
45+3' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) decides to speed play up with a short corner kick.
45+3' The corner from Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is intercepted by Ionut Radu.
45+1' The game is interrupted. Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) is given a yellow card. He has to be more careful now.
45+1' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) is awarded a yellow card and sent off by Juan Martinez because it's his second one today.

45+1' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) has a good opportunity as he meets a cross on the edge of the six-yard box and heads it towards the target. One of the defenders stands on the goal line and manages to keep the ball out. The linesman points to the corner flag, Real Sociedad are going to take it.
45' A quickly taken corner by Real Sociedad.

45' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety. Real Sociedad have been awarded a corner kick.
44' Real Sociedad are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
40' The corner is flicked onto Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad), but his close-range header flies a whisker wide of the left post.
40' Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) takes the corner.
40' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger. Good work from Real Sociedad as they win a corner.
37' Today's referee Juan Martinez rightly decides to book Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) for his harsh tackle.
37' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) fouls an opponent. At least that's what referee Juan Martinez signals.
35' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
33' Juan Martinez shows a yellow card to Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) for a tough tackle.
33' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
30' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) can't expect anything else than a yellow card for his hard tackle. And a yellow it is. Juan Martinez didn't think twice about pulling it out of his pocket.
30' Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) deprives his opponent of the ball, but the referee blows his whistle for a foul. He's not happy with the decision!
27' The linesman raises his flag as one of the players from Real Sociedad was in an offside position.
27' Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul after Carl Starfelt (Celta Vigo) hacks down one of his opponents.
25' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) sends a cross into the box, but Ionut Radu comes off his line to gather the ball.
23' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.

20' 1 - 0 Goal! Oscar Mingueza displays great vision and sends a pass to Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo), who shows brilliant composure inside the box to bury the ball from close range in the back of the net. The score is 1:0.
18' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) was too forceful with his tackle and Juan Martinez interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
17' Celta Vigo quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
15' The Real Sociedad players are displaying brilliant short passes and great ball movement. They are waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

12' That didn't go as planned! Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) tried his luck from the edge of the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal was too weak to get past Ionut Radu, who easily kept it out.
11' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) is clearly in an offside position after the ball is played through to him and the linesman raises his flag.
10' Borja Iglesias (Celta Vigo) commits a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for an infringement.
9' Oscar Mingueza (Celta Vigo) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.
7' Mikel Oyarzabal (Real Sociedad) jumps for a cross in the goal area and produces a fine header which goes just a few inches over the bar! What a huge opportunity!
7' Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
4' Pablo Duran (Celta Vigo) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
3' Yangel Herrera (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and Juan Martinez blows his whistle for a foul.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
The players are on the pitch and Celta Vigo will have the kick-off.
Juan Martinez was nominated as the referee for this game.
